meaning: Only tests whose assertions were inspected are mapped. Missing test outcomes remain not_run; this is not a source-coverage pass list.

bindings.check: 读取项目档案及版本戳
bindings.behavior: Reads live credits, falls back to retained snapshot after malformed live bytes, and verifies archive stamp and missing-project errors.
Removes the project from visible library records and asserts its retained snapshot still exists.
Runs the real core CLI after hiding original and fork records; each reappears with its own existing project identity.
Persists a model-group preference under a project ID containing dots and reads the same per-project value after migration.
Writes and rereads application/project preferences, preserves unknown fields and privacy, and verifies four real processes merge100 updates without partial JSON.
Cancels running workers, waits for in-flight progress callbacks, and checks process-group descendants stop even after the command leader exits.
Rejects a second live analysis as busy and verifies a crashed desktop owner cannot release an active worker lease for duplicate recovery.
Cancels active analysis and then runs a replacement worker that returns a verified restarted result; an old cancellation token cannot cancel the new job.

bindings.check: 安装及卸载发布工作流
bindings.behavior: Installs and removes the actual generated release workflow and refuses to overwrite an unrelated user-owned workflow.

bindings.check: 进程退出后恢复持久任务状态
bindings.behavior: Loads a persisted running task as interrupted after owner exit, resumes its original repo/language, marks completion, and leaves live leased tasks running.
Drops the running background service, waits for analysis termination and asserts the worker cannot create its later-write marker.

bindings.check: 部分结果和事务的一致性
bindings.behavior: Rejects malformed live data in favor of a retained snapshot, verifies atomic settings across processes, and preserves existing export history bytes on stale revision or malformed state.

bindings.check: 恢复不覆盖错误输入或旧任务
bindings.behavior: Rejects stale writes, malformed/future history, missing archives and invalid destinations; rejected enqueue leaves the full recovery snapshot unchanged.
Equivalent export inputs/destination deduplicate despite changed transport IDs, and retry cannot create a duplicate newer pending export.

bindings.check: 切换项目后任务仍完成到原请求
bindings.behavior: Queued retry retains its captured destination and grouping options, and stale completion cannot finish a newer attempt.

bindings.check: 错误不吞掉、允许再次发起
bindings.behavior: A simulated disk-full error can be retried successfully; journal conflicts report a visible retrievable error and stop further destructive saves.
Hidden views block animation preparation and viewport updates do not render while invisible; becoming visible resumes the current frame plan.
Pause blocks producer work, cancellation wakes it, and seeking/replay updates the epoch so obsolete frames are discarded.

bindings.check: 缩放锚点和拖动坐标一致
bindings.behavior: Checks the same world point remains under the cursor across zoom transformations.

bindings.check: 缓存按缩放档和像素密度失效
bindings.behavior: Checks physical pixel density at high DPI/deep zoom and invalidates the paused frame when viewport scale changes.
Exhaustively samples positive/negative columns and rows and asserts the original artwork order and per-lap variant rotation.

bindings.check: 仅挂载可见区附近作品
bindings.behavior: Pans tens of millions of pixels, keeps visible tile count and geometry storage bounded, revisits the original layout exactly, and skips empty artwork.
Lays out mixed one- and two-column spans and checks every pair for overlap.
